cn.t: Critics praise Berthelsen's committed performance in this tribute to the 1984 Bhopal disaster, but find the 90-minute monologue uneven. While the play's ambition and importance earn respect, many note pacing issues and melodramatic tendencies before reaching the tragedy itself.
